_comment: Single source of truth for mechanical layout. Units: mm. ONE frame for everything: origin = interior floor, front-left corner of the INTERIOR (inside the walls and the left end cap). +X along the length (left->right), +Y front->back, +Z up. Interior = 142 x 90 x 66. Board-local coordinates: origin at the board's front-left corner, top view, +X right, +Y toward the back edge; a board's 'position' is where its local origin sits in the interior frame. The PCB layout (KiCad) and the website 3D model both read this file. Rev B, 2026-11-21: fixes the 14 inconsistencies found by the 3D model build and applies the review-round-1 board partition (H-3).
changes_from_rev_A: One coordinate frame (interior); all centres re-derived (rev A mixed outer/interior centres).
Partition: RTL8372N switch + NICs on board A; RTL8221B PHY + RJ45 + PoE + router + radios + audio + Qi + glow on board B; DC jacks stay on A.
Boards widened to 89 mm (0.5 mm from the inner walls) so edge connectors reach the wall; boards slide into extrusion card-guide slots (no standoffs over the cartridge).
Z stack re-planned: cartridge 0-25, board A at 30 (5 mm gap for THT leads), board B at 47, Qi coil and speaker under the top wall clear of board B's height limits.
Board B shortened to 96 mm so a 30x30x10 fan stands vertically at the right end, aligned with the back-face grille.
Cells side by side along X with axes along Y (105.5 x 70.2 fits the 112 x 82 cartridge).
Left end cap lengthened to 16 mm for a 20 mm TIR optic; Qi window and speaker no longer overlap.

enclosure.type: extruded aluminium body with two PC/ABS end caps; boards ride in card-guide slots in the extrusion

glow_strip.note: light pipe on the flat front face (flat face spans z 4..60 interior)

connector.note: blind-mate at the inner (left) end of the bay, on a bracket under board A

boards.name: Power board (A)
boards.mounting: card-guide slots along both long edges (1.5 mm engagement) + 2 screws into end-cap bosses at x 3 and x 138 on the centre line
boards.assembly: SMT top side only + THT connectors
contents: 4x USB-C port stages (BQ25756 + TPS26750 + TPD4S480 + HD3SS3212 + RTL8156BG + 0.95 V buck)
input stage (DC jack eFuse + ORing + BQ25756)
fan (stands at the right end, see external_parts)

4x RTL8156BG NICs + RTL8372N switch (MDI inner stripline < 50 mm)
B2B strip (2x24 2.54 mm low-speed/power + HS mezzanine), mirrored on board B

zones.name: RJ45 + RTL8221B + PoE PD + isolated flyback
Qi transmitter (under the coil, max 12 mm)

boards.name: LED board (aluminium core)
boards.orientation: faces -X into the 20 mm TIR optic in the left end cap

external_parts.name: Fan 30x30x10 (vertical, blowing out the back grille)
external_parts.note: x/y/z = min corner; axis along +Y; spans z 32-62, above board A (top 31.6) and right of board B (ends x 96.5)

external_parts.name: Speaker 40 mm 4 ohm
external_parts.note: centre x/y; z = bottom; top at 65.8 under the 66 mm interior top

external_parts.name: Qi coil A11 (50 mm) + ferrite
external_parts.note: centre x/y; z = bottom; top at 65.8

notes: All positions are pre-layout estimates; the layout must keep the edge-connector positions and the z stack.
Board B ends at x 96.5; the fan and the right end cap door path occupy x 102-142 above board A.
